items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Gene Ammons in the context of a story about Don Byas, but the interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not speak or confirm any personal interaction with Gene Ammons in the provided text.

ctx.x: Yeah, I guess he went back to Dallas a few years after that, and that's I guess where he still is. Would you want to tell that story about Don Byas coming to visit you in the London House?
Yes, surely. This was just a few years ago. And he and Gene Ammons and Dexter Gordon, that is correct, they were having this battle of tenors and our boy, what's his name? Sponsored it.
